"""Edge-case tests for the replay engine."""
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.engine import run_request

failures = []


def check(name, got, expected):
    if got != expected:
        failures.append(name)
        print('FAIL', name)
        print('  got     ', json.dumps(got))
        print('  expected', json.dumps(expected))
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


SETTINGS = {'trials': 3, 'epsilon': 1000, 'seed': 5, 'cutoff': [0, 1],
            'bias': 0, 'tau': 0, 'gamma': [1, 1], 'cache_slots': 2}


def run(events, topo, settings=SETTINGS):
    return run_request({'streams': [{'topology': topo, 'settings': settings,
                                     'events': events}]})['streams'][0]['events']


# sparse ids, long names, no external nodes
t1 = {
    'nodes': [
        {'id': 65535, 'name': 'Abbbbbbbbbb', 'external_capacity': 7},
        {'id': 0, 'name': 'Z9', 'external_capacity': 1000000000},
        {'id': 17, 'name': 'Q', 'external_capacity': 0},
    ],
    'links': [{'source': 65535, 'target': 0, 'capacity': 0},
              {'source': 0, 'target': 17, 'capacity': 9}],
    'external_nodes': [],
}
out = run([{'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'}, {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'a'}], t1)
check('no external nodes repair',
      (len(out[0]['links']), out[0]['order'], out[0]['counters']),
      (4, [[0, 17], [17, 0], [0, 65535], [65535, 0]], {}))
check('no external nodes validate',
      out[1], {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'a', 'checked': 0, 'passed': 0,
               'consistent': None, 'failed': []})
check('counter keys sparse ids', sorted(k for k in [
    'low_Abbbbbbbbbb_egress_to_Z9', 'low_Z9_ingress_from_Abbbbbbbbbb',
    'low_Z9_egress_to_Abbbbbbbbbb', 'low_Abbbbbbbbbb_ingress_from_Z9',
    'low_Z9_egress_to_Q', 'low_Q_ingress_from_Z9',
    'low_Q_egress_to_Z9', 'low_Z9_ingress_from_Q']) if k not in out[0]['counters'],
      [])

# zero capacity flows: predictions and reports clamp to zero
t2 = {
    'nodes': [{'id': 1, 'name': 'A', 'external_capacity': 0},
              {'id': 2, 'name': 'B', 'external_capacity': 50}],
    'links': [{'source': 1, 'target': 2, 'capacity': 0}],
    'external_nodes': ['A', 'B'],
}
out = run([
    {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[1, 2, 30]], 'counters': {
        'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': 0},
        'low_B_termination': {'perturbed': 0}}},
    {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'x', 'paths': {
        'A': {'B': [{'path': ['A', 'B'], 'weight': 1000}]},
        'B': {'A': [{'path': ['B', 'A'], 'weight': 1000}]}}},
    {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'z'},
    {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'z'},
], t2)
vals = {(l[0], l[1]): l[2] for l in out[2]['links']}
check('zero capacity clamps', vals[(-1, 1)], 0)
check('zero capacity internal', vals[(1, 2)], 0)
check('nonzero external', vals[(-1, 2)], 0)
check('zero cap validate', (out[3]['checked'], out[3]['passed']), (6, 2))

# many repair events, cache hits, repeated snapshot ids
t3 = {
    'nodes': [{'id': 0, 'name': 'A', 'external_capacity': 10},
              {'id': 1, 'name': 'B', 'external_capacity': 10}],
    'links': [{'source': 0, 'target': 1, 'capacity': 10}],
    'external_nodes': ['A', 'B'],
}
events = [{'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 4]],
           'counters': {'low_A_egress_to_B': {'perturbed': 4}}}]
for i in range(60):
    events.append({'op': 'repair', 'id': 'snap%d' % (i % 4)})
out = run(events, t3)
hits = [e['cache_hit'] for e in out if e['op'] == 'repair']
check('repeat repairs hit', (hits[0], hits[1], hits[59]), (False, True, True))
check('repeat repairs stable',
      out[59]['links'] == out[0]['links'], True)

# repair with nothing at all (all missing, no routes)
t4 = {'nodes': [{'id': 3, 'name': 'Solo', 'external_capacity': 9}],
      'links': [], 'external_nodes': ['Solo']}
out = run([{'op': 'repair', 'id': 'n'}, {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'n'}], t4)
check('missing everything', out[0]['links'], [[-1, 3, 0, 3, 1], [3, -1, 0, 3, 1]])
check('missing everything validate', out[1]['checked'], 2)

# routes to null again changes the cache key
t5 = {
    'nodes': [{'id': 0, 'name': 'A', 'external_capacity': 40},
              {'id': 1, 'name': 'B', 'external_capacity': 40}],
    'links': [{'source': 0, 'target': 1, 'capacity': 40}],
    'external_nodes': ['A', 'B'],
}
plan = {'A': {'B': [{'path': ['A', 'B'], 'weight': 1000}]},
        'B': {'A': [{'path': ['B', 'A'], 'weight': 1000}]}}
out = run([
    {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 7], [1, 0, 2]],
     'counters': {'low_A_egress_to_B': {'perturbed': 5}}},
    {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'p', 'paths': plan},
    {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'},
    {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'q', 'paths': None},
    {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'b'},
    {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'r', 'paths': plan},
    {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'c'},
], t5)
check('null plan then back', [e['cache_hit'] for e in out if e['op'] == 'repair'],
      [False, False, True])

# empty object plan with a single external node
t6 = {'nodes': [{'id': 0, 'name': 'A', 'external_capacity': 10},
                {'id': 1, 'name': 'B', 'external_capacity': 10}],
      'links': [{'source': 0, 'target': 1, 'capacity': 10}],
      'external_nodes': ['A']}
out = run([
    {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [], 'counters': {}},
    {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'e', 'paths': {}},
    {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'},
    {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'a'},
], t6)
check('single external node plan', out[3]['checked'], 2)

print()
print('FAILURES:', failures if failures else 'none')
PYEOF
